name: Century Therapeutics, Inc.
summary: Century Therapeutics, Inc., a biotechnology company, engages in the development of allogeneic cell therapies for the treatment of solid tumor, hematological malignancies, and autoimmune diseases. Its lead product candidate is CNTY-813, an iPSC-derived beta islet cell replacement therapy engineered with Allo-Evasion 5.0 for the treatment of type 1 diabetes.
